title: terminalia canescens
intro: Terminalia canescens, commonly known as Tumia, is a plant species belonging to the Combretaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Terminalia canescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-hyperglycemic, anti-hypertensive, and anti-cancer effects. The health benefits of Terminalia canescens include improved cardiovascular health, enhanced immune function, and potential anti-cancer properties.
